threads.body: Neither `gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk` nor `gen_ai.client.inference.time_to_first_chunk` has a reference scenario demonstrating these rules. The attribute's coverage is `(none)` in `reference/reports/inference-span.md:43`; the OpenAI streaming scenario reads `choice.delta.content` but records neither signal. `.github/instructions/evaluate-reference.instructions.md:7-9,22-23` requires reference coverage for changed conventions too. Extend a real SDK streaming scenario to measure both signals from before the SDK call to the first qualifying output. Demonstrate skipping metadata-only events, including a retry and its backoff without resetting the timer, and omitting both signals when no qualifying output arrives. Refresh the captured telemetry and reports with the scenario change.

replies.body: Added in 3f1dd901. The OpenAI streaming scenario now records both signals from before the SDK call to the first qualifying delta. It also checks metadata-only events, non-text output, authentication, retry backoff without resetting the timer, and streams with no output through the real SDK with mocked HTTP responses and a controlled clock. The assertions run in the existing scenario entry point. Captured telemetry and the coverage report are refreshed.

threads.body: The new note starts the clock before the first attempt and includes authentication and the retry backoff, but the brief on this metric still starts when the client issues the generation request. The [time to first chunk attribute](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/blob/12a427fa74e999b120c5abbaff73f652c8335b0d/model/gen-ai/registry.yaml#L272-L275) brief still says request issuance, and [inference duration](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/blob/12a427fa74e999b120c5abbaff73f652c8335b0d/model/gen-ai/metrics.yaml#L44-L50) uses that request start and is supposed to match the span. The note and those briefs are describing different starts.

replies.body: Updated both TTFC notes in 3f1dd901 to define request issuance as the start of the logical inference operation, before authentication and the first attempt. This is the operation-level start intended by the existing briefs and the [SIG conclusion](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/issues/306#issuecomment-6293832701), and is consistent with the logical client span wording merged in #562. The reference scenario verifies that authentication and retry backoff are included. Leaving this thread open for your confirmation of the wording.

The notes now use explicit SHOULD and MUST NOT requirements: record TTFC when the first qualifying chunk arrives, exclude empty or metadata-only events, and omit the signal when no chunk arrives.
